# Claude Project Memory — Snapshot 2026-07-26
### The reviewer's persistent memory for Project Naiad, exported verbatim for the repository record

**What this file is.** Claude (the reviewer) carries two layers of persistent memory in the claude.ai project: an **auto-generated project memory** (synthesized from conversation history, refreshed periodically) and **operator-ratified memory edits** (explicit entries added on instruction, numbered, durable). This snapshot preserves both verbatim as of 2026-07-26, so the repository — not a proprietary memory store — is the durable record of what the reviewer knows.

**Convention:** snapshots are append-only. Future exports are new dated files under `docs/memory/`; this file is never edited. Discrepancies between a snapshot and live memory resolve in favor of the ledger, then the newest snapshot.

---

## Section 1 — Auto-generated project memory (verbatim)

**Purpose & context**

Ludwig is a discretionary cryptocurrency trader systematizing his intuitive trading decisions into a rigorous, pre-registered mechanical research framework. He has no programming background and works with two AI agents: Claude (Project) as independent reviewer operating under "Fable-mode" discipline, and Claude Code as the builder executing locally on a Windows/PowerShell environment.

**Core project:** Project Naiad / v12 Study — a mechanical crypto trading system backtested on exploration-classic data using a Python replay engine that ports logic from a proprietary TradingView Pine Script indicator called "Secret Sauce Cascade" (SSv11.x). The pre-registered asset grid is 10 Binance USDT-M perpetuals (BTC, ETH, SOL, NEAR, ZEC, JTO, TAO, HYPE, FARTCOIN, LIT-Lighter) across three mandates: swing (4H/5m), intraday (1H/1m), and position (12H/15m) = 30 cells. Repository lives on a Windows/OneDrive path under a parent folder called "Midas-Claude Code Resources."

**Guiding philosophy (operator's words):** "The alpha is buried under a pile of debris. We explore, examine, and implement a continuous improvement mindset to achieve our goal." Concretely: (1) Never retire underperforming mandates — stay with the problem until the mechanism is apparent, then fix it. (2) Do not reorder work around fees/execution before the strategy has demonstrable edge. (3) Priority order: better trade-birth filters → effective stop ratchet → working take-profit that keeps profit.

**Reviewer-builder-operator triad:**
- Ludwig = operator; owns all merges and gate decisions
- Claude (Project) = reviewer; independent verification, pre-registered predictions, append-only ledger, owns falsifications on record
- Claude Code = builder; executes contracts locally, never merges without operator sign-off

**Methodology tiers:**
- Tier A: Journal arithmetic — free, no pre-registration required
- Tier B: Instrumented replay — trading logic unchanged, byte-identity enforced
- Tier C: Rule changes — must be pre-registered under G-7 (ledger line with config sha, hypothesis, prediction) before execution

**Key domain terminology:**
- R: One unit of planned risk (0.5% of cell equity)
- cell-R: Size-weighted realized R across the grid
- exploration-classic: The scorable historical partition (through June 2024); lockbox = July 2024–October 2025 (sealed, untouched); spent BTC window = used for development, not valid for out-of-sample testing
- PROTECTED paradox: 90.35% of trades touching +1R MFE exit at a gross loss with zero stop advances before peak
- cost identity: cost-in-R = cost_bps ÷ stop_bps
- mc=3: The pyramid cohort — first robustly positive population (+4.88 expectancy, 72.6% win rate, positive at 2× costs)
- beacon: Two-axis ratchet scorecard of capture% vs noise-stopout%
- governor/exec timeframe pairing: 4H/5m swing, 1H/1m intraday (→ TC-5: 1H/5m re-spec), 12H/15m position
- F-BYTE: Byte-identity acceptance fixture
- G-7: Pre-registration mandate for all Tier-C runs
- G-8: Engine guards (equity floor 25% of initial equity, notional cap 10×, min-stop 0.5 ATR, one_r>0 assert)
- Campaign: A coordinated multi-tranche trade sequence; add = increases size in an open position (nomenclature fixed); re-entry = fill with nothing open
- PROTECTED / STILLBORN / NEVER_GREEN / FADED: Tranche taxonomy cohorts
- Fractal lens (standing analytic frame): Price structure may replicate across timeframes with scale-adapted variables. Working hypothesis: GROSS behavior is fractal-compatible; NET behavior is provably not, because costs are scale-invariant in bps while excursions scale with TF — "same animal, different tax bracket." TC-5 (1H/5m re-spec) = fractal repair. All MTF tables must print absolute AND governor-relative coordinates.

**Key learnings & principles**

- **PROTECTED paradox:** 90.35% of trades touching +1R MFE exit at a gross loss with zero stop advances before peak — the harvest mechanism is a primary failure point, not entry quality
- **Cost identity is decisive:** cost-in-R = cost_bps ÷ stop_bps; re-entries carry 83% of clean-grid loss; costs are scale-invariant in bps while excursions scale with TF — NET behavior is provably not fractal even when GROSS behavior is
- **mc=3 as proof-of-concept:** The pyramid cohort is the first robustly positive population, confirming buried alpha exists and directing attention to trade-birth and stop quality
- **Sizing is currently negative first-order:** All sizing levers worsen results on the current book; sizing work formally deferred until exits have demonstrable edge
- **Evidence spend is irreversible:** First-look consumption of lockbox data cannot be undone; gate discipline and pre-registration are non-negotiable
- **Pivot-over-abandon posture:** Every failure is a useful data point; never retire underperforming mandates before the mechanism is understood
- **FH-3 confirmed:** MTF gradient is relative to governor (not absolute timeframe) — cross-TF signals should be expressed in governor-relative steps; swing's stage structure is MTF-redundant at the governor level
- **Fractal lens working hypothesis confirmed for GROSS, falsified for NET:** TC-5 (1H/5m re-spec) is the first concrete fractal repair attempt

**Reporting format (ratified 2026-07-15):** Major deliverables follow the "V3 Forensics Report 2 — The Deep Dive" model: zero-context plain-language explainer that explains the whole project and every mechanism from scratch, defines all jargon, states provenance per claim as verified/measured/expect/open, ends with an options menu and reasoning. Purpose: allows Ludwig to verify work conceptually without holding full project context in mind and without programming background.

**Reviewer discipline (Fable-mode):**
- Every headline number independently recomputed from raw artifacts before acceptance
- Pre-register predictions with explicit probabilities before investigating
- Own falsifications on the record; append-only ledger
- Byte-identity enforced for all Tier-B passes (F-BYTE fixture)
- Nothing merges without operator sign-off; git push remains manual per governance rule

**Decision-making:** Options menus with reasoning at every fork; operator makes one-word or explicit ratification decisions. All Tier-C runs pre-registered under G-7 before execution.

**MTF reporting convention:** All MTF tables print absolute AND governor-relative coordinates.

**Analytic frame:** Fractal lens is a standing frame — never treat cross-TF signals/outcomes as categorically different by default; study correlations explicitly and falsifiably; express all add/re-entry rules in governor-relative steps.
